est_products: Unknown from official site. Sonic Electric Orbit collection: 1255 products / 2080 variants (all with images); Wire & Co (shopwirenco.com) Orbit collection: 671 products (225 with images); MROSupply brand listing ~74 pages.
sku_format_match: partial - Orbit's own model numbers are dashed (LB-200AS, SSLN-50, RW-250/75, RN-500-C) while many Lumera SKUs are undashed (LB200AS, SSLN50, RW25075, RN500C). Matching works after stripping all non-alphanumerics. 5 of 12 samples matched on Sonic Electric.

alternatives.name: Sonic Electric
alternatives.notes: Reachable, vendor 'Orbit Industries, Inc.', variant.sku = Orbit dashed model number. 1255 products/2080 variants, 0 without images. Images are generic per product family (e.g. LB-200AS shows lb-50as.jpg), not per size. Near-misses observed: EC300 (vs EC-300L), FLBDSS/FLBDDBR (vs FLBDDSS).

alternatives.name: Wire & Co (shopwirenco.com)
alternatives.notes: 671 Orbit products, only 225 with images; variant.sku is an internal numeric id, model number only in title ('Orbit Industries <MODEL> ...'). Only 1 of 12 samples (RN500C) matched; its image is product-specific (OrbitIndustries_RN500C_Image1-REP.jpg).

alternatives.name: MROSupply
alternatives.notes: Brand page reachable; search endpoint returned empty reply; the one product page checked (FLB-D-C-SS) had no product image (noimage.webp) and no JSON-LD. Low value.

recommended_strategy: Harvest Sonic Electric Orbit collection products.json (6 pages). Index variant.sku normalized to [A-Z0-9] only and match Lumera SKUs the same way; use variant.featured_image else product.images[0]. Supplement with shopwirenco.com titles (regex 'Orbit Industries (\S+)') for misses. Expect roughly 40% coverage with family-level images; the official site cannot be harvested from here.
blockers: orbitelectric.com (homepage, products.json, sitemap.xml, product pages) returns Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge (403) to curl and WebFetch.
